changes: Title pages now find every copy: a video posted in parts counts as the whole video it joins into, and copies matched to the same title online fold in too, so the versions a page shows match what search found
Search answers as you type: each new letter narrows the answer already on screen instead of starting the search over, and pages that add nothing no longer rebuild the list
Search understands names better: initials find the full title they open, small spelling slips still match, and the order of the words does not matter
Movie and series pages carry the same bottom bar as the rest of the app, so Home, Chats, Search, Settings and Profile stay one tap away
Home always settles: a slow answer can no longer hold the loading screen, and the rows keep arriving behind it once it settles
Cast pages settle faster: each held video's saved title is read as it stands instead of being worked out again for every credit
notes: Complete versions on title pages, search that answers letter by letter, the bottom bar on movie and series pages, and a Home that always settles.
